name: Google Shape;84;p4
text: Smart devices are not just software
textPreview: Smart devices are not just software

text:
In traditional IT systems we think mainly about software vulnerabilities.
But smart connected devices are different. They include multiple hardware components, secure elements, and third-party modules.
Some vulnerabilities exist in hardware, and many critical assets are managed directly by hardware components.
So without a model that includes hardware, vulnerability management for devices is incomplete.

name: Google Shape;132;p8
text:
For each Processing Unit (PU), ARIANNA supports the creation of the SBOM.
A PU SBOM can combine multiple SBOMs.
MPUs can include an OS SBOM plus SBOMs for customer applications.
MCUs can include a bootloader SBOM plus a firmware SBOM.
Components in the final SBOM are grouped accordingly.
Each SBOM is created with support from a dedicated ARIANNA SCA tool.

text:

HBOM usually stays constant.
SBOM should be updated whenever a new firmware or software release is made.
When a new device model version is created, new vulnerabilities may appear.
Existing vulnerabilities can remain open or close automatically if affected components are updated or removed.

A vulnerability in a component that is not exposed to the network is very different from the same vulnerability in an internet-facing device.
Exploitability matters more than quantity
Fixing 50 theoretical vulnerabilities does not improve security as much as fixing 5 vulnerabilities that can really be exploited.

name: Google Shape;237;p15
text: Severity alone is no longer enough
textPreview: Severity alone is no longer enough

text:
Today most vulnerability management processes are based mainly on severity scores like CVSS.
And CVSS is absolutely useful — it gives us a standard way to measure how dangerous a vulnerability could be.

The problem is that severity does not tell us how dangerous a vulnerability is for our specific device.

We are measuring vulnerabilities correctly, but we are prioritizing them incorrectly.

Smart connected devices have different risks than IT systems
Most scoring systems were created for IT environments.
But smart connected devices have firmware, hardware dependencies, and very different attack surfaces.

title: ARIANNA KEV focuses on vulnerabilities with evidence of exploitation.

name: Google Shape;312;p21
text:
ARIANNA KEV focuses on vulnerabilities with evidence of exploitation.
It includes vulnerabilities from the CISA KEV catalogue.
It also includes proof-of-exploitation signals from EUVD and verified or weaponized exploits detected by ARIANNA.
This provides broader and faster coverage than relying on CISA KEV alone.
Result: faster prioritization and remediation.
